events.title: GCC X Hyderabad Enterprise AI & Tech Conclave 2026

events.eligibility: Open to technology leaders, AI architects, enterprise software engineers, and founders.

events.title: FOSS United Hyderabad Summit 2026
events.prize_text: ₹1,00,000 FOSS Project Grants for top open-source demos
events.eligibility: Open to all open source developers, Linux enthusiasts, and contributors.

events.title: DevFest Hyderabad 2026 – Flagship Google Developer Festival
events.prize_text: Official DevFest Hyderabad T-Shirts, Goodies & Google Swag
events.eligibility: Open to all developers, mobile app creators, AI engineers, and tech students.
events.description: DevFest is the annual community-run tech conference organized by GDG Hyderabad at JRC Conventions, Gachibowli Road. Featuring 4 parallel tracks on AI & Machine Learning, Web & Cloud, Android, and Career Growth.

events.title: PyConf Hyderabad 2026 – Regional Python Conference
events.prize_text: ₹50,000 Open Source Contributor Grants & HydPy Badges
events.eligibility: Open to all Python programmers, data scientists, educators, and university students.
events.description: Two-day conference at IIIT Hyderabad Campus featuring Python in production, Polars, PyTorch model deployment, and PyScript, with interactive contributor sprints.

events.title: XConf India 2026 – AI-First Engineering Summit
events.prize_text: Tech books, Thoughtworks swag, and exclusive conference kit
events.eligibility: Software engineers, tech leads, system architects, and senior developers.
events.description: Thoughtworks annual flagship technology conference in Hyderabad (Knowledge City, HITEC City). Deep technical talks on AI-augmented software development, event-driven microservices, and high-leverage engineering patterns.

events.title: Cloud Native & KubeDay Hyderabad 2026
events.organizer: Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) Hyderabad Chapter
events.prize_text: CNCF Community Swag & Kubernetes Certified Exam discount codes
events.eligibility: Open to platform engineers, SREs, Kubernetes administrators, and cloud engineers.
events.description: CNCF community conference hosted in the auditorium at Microsoft Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad. Covering Kubernetes v1.32 internals, eBPF observability, service mesh, and GitOps at enterprise scale.

events.title: T-Hub BuildX & AI NextGen Summit 2026
events.prize_text: ₹2,50,000 Incubation Grants & T-Hub Co-Working Passes
events.eligibility: Open to student entrepreneurs, startup founders, AI engineers, and tech innovators.
events.description: Hosted at T-Hub Phase 2 (Knowledge City, Rai Durg, Hyderabad), the world's largest innovation campus. Features product showcases, live venture capital pitching, AI startup demo stations, and founder mentorship.

events.title: AWS Community Day Hyderabad 2026
events.prize_text: AWS Swags, Certification vouchers, and AWS Cloud Credits
events.eligibility: Cloud architects, DevOps practitioners, AWS developers, and student cloud builders.
events.description: The largest community-run AWS tech conference in Telangana, bringing AWS Heroes, Community Builders, and enterprise cloud architects together for sessions on Amazon Bedrock, serverless scale, and zero-trust cloud security.

events.title: Google Cloud Community Day Hyderabad 2026 (GCCD)
events.organizer: Google Cloud Community Hyderabad & GDG Cloud
events.prize_text: Exclusive Google Cloud Badges, T-Shirts, and GCP Cloud Credits
events.eligibility: Open to all cloud developers, DevOps specialists, data engineers, and tech students.
events.description: Annual Google Cloud Community Day hosted in Hyderabad near HITEC City. Covers Gemini multimodal APIs, Vertex AI, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and secure cloud deployment architectures.

events.title: Microsoft Reactor Generative AI Masterclass: Production RAG & Fine-Tuning
events.prize_text: Official Microsoft Reactor Certificate of Completion
events.eligibility: Open to AI engineers, cloud practitioners, and graduate developers.
events.description: Live in-person technical masterclass at Microsoft Campus Building 1, Gachibowli, Hyderabad. Deep-dive into hybrid search, vector embeddings, fine-tuning SLMs, and evaluation metrics with Microsoft Senior Cloud Solution Architects.

events.title: Agentic AI & Autonomous Workflows Builders Meetup 2026
events.organizer: Global AI Hyderabad & Hyderabad AI Guild (Hosted at Microsoft)
events.prize_text: AI Demo Winners: Cloud credits & Azure AI swags
events.eligibility: Open to software engineers, AI researchers, and students building agentic tools and Multi-Agent Systems.
events.description: A hands-on developer meetup at Microsoft Building 1, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, centered on building Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), Autogen, CrewAI, and LangGraph pipelines with Azure AI models.

events.title: IntelliCON 2026 – Advanced Agentic & Generative AI Conference
events.organizer: Global AI Community Hyderabad & Cloud Native Community (Hosted at Microsoft)
events.prize_text: Certificate of Participation & Microsoft Community Swag
events.eligibility: Open to all software developers, AI engineers, tech architects, and engineering students. Gate entry at Microsoft Campus requires government or college photo ID.
events.description: IntelliCON 2026 is an in-person tech community conference hosted at Microsoft Campus (Building 1), ISB Road, Gachibowli, Hyderabad. Featuring deep-dive keynotes, technical tracks, and live architecture demos on Autonomous Agents, Azure OpenAI, LLM orchestration, and enterprise production systems.

events.title: The Equinox 2.0 - Annual E-Summit 2026
events.prize_text: ₹1,50,000+ Cash & Incubation Grants
events.eligibility: Open to all engineering and college students, aspiring entrepreneurs, and innovators. Teams of 4–5 members.
events.description: The Equinox 2.0 is the premier 2-day national E-Summit organized by the Centre for Innovation & Entrepreneurship (CIE) at MLR Institute of Technology (MLRIT), Dundigal, Hyderabad. Flagship tracks include Startup Expo, Pitch Deck to active venture capitalists and angel investors, IPL Auction strategic bidding simulation, Brand Battles, Crossroads business crisis challenge, Hustle Mania live stall challenge, Startup-Poly board challenge, and exclusive Internship Drive & E-Cell Meet. Evenings feature Stand-up Comedy and Musical Night. Delegate Pass: ₹769. Venue: MLRIT Campus, Dundigal, Gandi Maisamma, Hyderabad 500043.

events.title: Megathon 2026 - Hyderabad's Premier Student Hackathon
events.eligibility: Open to all enrolled undergraduate and postgraduate students from recognized colleges.
events.description: Megathon is Hyderabad's largest student-driven hackathon hosted at IIIT Hyderabad, Gachibowli. 24 hours of non-stop coding, problem-solving, and mentoring across AI/ML, Blockchain, and Smart Cities with cloud credits and direct internship interviews.

events.title: Sudhee 2026 - CBIT National 24-Hour Hackathon
events.organizer: Chaitanya Bharathi Institute of Technology (CBIT), Gandipet
events.eligibility: All college students with valid student ID.
events.description: Part of CBIT's flagship technical festival Sudhee at Gandipet campus. Build functional prototypes in HealthTech, EdTech, FinTech, and Smart Agriculture with industry judges from Hyderabad's IT corridor.

events.title: HackVJ 2026 - 24-Hour National Collegiate Hackathon
events.organizer: VNR Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering & Technology, Bachupally
events.eligibility: Undergraduate and engineering students.
events.description: Organized by the ACM student chapter at VNR VJIET (Bachupally/Nizampet). 24 hours of rapid development, live coding challenges, and mentoring sessions.

events.title: Acumen 2026 - National Technical Symposium & Code Jam
events.eligibility: B.E / B.Tech students.
events.description: CSE ACUMEN 2026 (Theme: Qubit Zero) was the annual national technical symposium hosted by the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at Vasavi College of Engineering (VCE), Hyderabad. The event was held on March 15, 2026 on Unstop (ID: 455943) and has concluded.

events.title: Trishul 2026 - National Code Odyssey & Hackathon
events.eligibility: Open to student developers and coders across India.
events.description: 36-Hour continuous software sprint focused on Systems Programming, Fullstack Development, and Generative AI at KMIT Campus, Narayanguda, Hyderabad.

events.title: Pragnya 2026 - National Level Technical Symposium
events.organizer: Gokaraju Rangaraju Institute of Engineering & Technology (GRIET)
events.eligibility: Open to all engineering college students.
events.description: Flagship tech fest at GRIET, Bachupally / Nizampet Road, Hyderabad. Features 24-hr Hackathon, Paper Presentation, RoboTrack, and Web Development Battle.

events.title: Promethean 2026 - All-India Technical Festival
events.eligibility: Open to all engineering and technology disciplines.
events.description: Annual technical fest showcasing innovative student projects, hackathons, and technical design challenges at BVRIT campus, Bachupally / Narsapur.

events.title: Roboveda & Sreevision 2026 - National Robotics & Tech Fest
events.eligibility: Open to college teams across India.
events.description: India's largest student-run robotics symposium and tech fest hosted at SNIST, Yamnampet, Ghatkesar, Hyderabad. Features RoboWars, Autonomous Drones, IoT Expo, and AI sprints.

events.title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2026 - Global Student Tech Championship
events.prize_text: $100,000 USD + Satya Nadella Mentorship + $50k Azure Grants
events.eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in accredited high schools or universities worldwide. Teams of 1-4 members.
events.description: Microsoft Imagine Cup is the world's premier student technology and innovation competition. Build purpose-driven applications utilizing Microsoft Azure, OpenAI models, and AI Copilot. Winners receive $100,000 USD, a 1-on-1 mentorship session with Microsoft Chairman & CEO Satya Nadella, and global media exposure.

events.title: Microsoft Fabric & Azure AI Copilot Innovation Challenge
events.prize_text: ₹3,50,000 + Surface Laptops & Microsoft AI Certifications
events.eligibility: Open to developers, data engineers, and student builders in India.
events.description: Architect intelligent enterprise copilot agents and real-time analytics data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric, Azure OpenAI, and Semantic Kernel. Includes hands-on workshops with Microsoft Cloud Solution Architects.

events.title: Google Solution Challenge 2026
events.prize_text: $12,000 USD per winning team + Google Engineering Mentorship
events.eligibility: University and college students worldwide. Teams of up to 4 members.
events.description: The Google Solution Challenge invites university students worldwide to develop solutions for one or more of the United Nations 17 Sustainable Development Goals using Google products including Flutter, Firebase, Google Cloud, and Gemini AI APIs.

events.title: Amazon HackOn 2026 - India Campus Edition
events.prize_text: ₹5,00,000 + Amazon SDE-1 Fast-Track Interviews
events.eligibility: B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MCA students graduating in 2026, 2027, or 2028 across engineering colleges in India.
events.description: Amazon India's flagship engineering campus competition. Test your coding, system design, and scalable algorithm skills on high-throughput logistics and customer delivery problems. Top performers earn fast-track interview opportunities for Amazon SDE-1 roles.

events.title: Flipkart GRiD 7.0 - Software Development & GenAI Track
events.prize_text: ₹6,00,000 + Direct Pre-Placement Interviews (PPI) for SDE-1
events.eligibility: Engineering students across all Indian colleges. Teams of 2 to 3 members.
events.description: Flipkart GRiD is Flipkart's flagship campus engineering challenge. Tracks include Generative AI for Conversational Commerce, Autonomous Robotics in Fulfillment, and High-Scale Low-Latency Infrastructure. Winners secure cash prizes and PPIs with Flipkart.

events.title: NVIDIA AI Developer Challenge - Generative AI Sprint
events.prize_text: $25,000 USD in NVIDIA RTX GPUs & Cloud Compute
events.eligibility: Open to developers, researchers, and students building with CUDA / PyTorch.
events.description: Build high-speed generative AI, computer vision, or multimodal agent pipelines accelerated by NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM and NVIDIA NIM microservices. Prizes include top-tier NVIDIA workstation GPUs and cloud credits.

events.title: Tata InnoVerse & Tata Crucible Hackathon 2026
events.prize_text: ₹4,00,000 + Tata Group Leadership Mentorship
events.eligibility: Full-time students enrolled in recognized Indian colleges and universities.
events.description: Tata InnoVerse challenges student innovators to solve real engineering problems for Tata companies in renewable energy, circular economy, and digital industrial automation. Finals held with Tata leadership.

events.title: IBM Call for Code Global Challenge 2026
events.prize_text: $50,000 USD + Red Hat & watsonx Deployment Incubation
events.eligibility: Developers, university students, and problem solvers worldwide.
events.description: The largest global tech initiative addressing humanitarian, sustainability, and disaster response challenges. Build open-source applications powered by IBM watsonx AI and Red Hat OpenShift.
